profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Developer with broad spectrum of knowledge, from low level/hardware to High level. In the last years have been focussed in low-level development (mostly C language and x86 assembly) and high performance algorithms using both instruction level parallelism (SIMD instructions) and task parallelism.  

Low level: Intel intrinsics, SIMD instructions, standard C, Operating System development, x86 assembly languaje, CPU atomic operations (compare-and-swap, Test-and-Set, FAA, etc), interrupt management, APIC, VHDL, real time systems, drivers development.

HL & OO: C++, C#, Delphi, OO Analisys & design, OO design patterns, UML

Scripting: python, VBA

Software correction: debugging, gdb, ddd, unit tests, automatic testing scripts, hardware breakpoints/watchpoints

Control&signals: automatic control, PID, digitizing analog signals, FFT

Compiler-Making: Bison, Yacc, Flex, PLY

Research and programing tasks in the field of EOG signal processing.  Keywords: EEG, EOG, Delphi, FFT, Medicid, peak detection, ocular stimulation.
Imparted undergraduate instruction (course: “C# programing”)
